english.title: Large packaging producer fail to retain evidence of recycling of relevant packaging waste - England
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a producer subject to the data collection obligations of a large producer other than an online marketplace buyer or seller in relation to packaging specified in the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023, namely **(..SPECIFY PACKAGING..), failed to retain evidence

(A)_[of relevant packaging waste you had collected during the data collection period of **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..) from other persons and sent for recycling]_
(B)_[that relevant packaging waste collected during the data collection period of **(..SPECIFY PERIOD..) consisting of your own and other persons packaging waste and sent for recycling to another nation identified by you in the United Kingdom had been recycled]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(3)(b)(ii) and 28(2)(a) and (7) of the Packaging Waste (Data Reporting) (England) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a producer

evidence of relevant packaging waste

during the relevant data collection period
had been recycled
